product.name: Fastgen Low-Code API and Workflow Builder
product.description: A low-code platform for creating APIs, backends, and automations using a drag-and-drop interface without requiring extensive coding.

product.name: Integrated PostgreSQL Database
product.description: A built-in PostgreSQL database integrated within the platform for managing application data alongside APIs and workflows.

product.name: Debug Mode
product.description: A feature that enables testing and debugging of APIs and workflows directly within the Fastgen platform.

product.name: Logging Feature
product.description: A logging system that records detailed information about API requests and workflow executions for monitoring and troubleshooting.

product.name: Third-Party Integrations
product.description: Native integrations with external services like Sendgrid, Twilio, Slack, and ChatGPT to extend workflow automation capabilities.
